title: FOOTPRINTS ON THE MAP: WHO WALKED HERE
said: do a full sweep, let's have some fun
why: The groups that roam the valley now leave pale shoe prints round your crew on the map, tinted to their colour and fading over a day, never a line of where they will walk. Stand on them and the line at the bottom of the map says who came through, on the map in the RUN tab.

before_after.before: main b94bd4920: the parties' prints drew only behind the F key, and a phone has no F key, so a phone never saw a track
before_after.after: the prints round him, as shoe prints in pairs, fading; standing on one, the map's own line names who came through
before_after.scale: his phone upright (390 x 844 at 3, top) and sideways (844 x 390 at 3, bottom), the alpha's RUN tab map, cut round his crew
